UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Private user account profile containing PII such as linked phone number, strictly readable and writable only by the authenticated owner.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

phoneNumber.description: Optional linked phone number in normalized format (0-20 chars).

avatarData.description: Optional profile image HTTPS URL or compressed Base64 data URI.

online.description: Whether the user is currently active in the app.

PublicProfile.title: PublicProfile
PublicProfile.description: Non-PII public chat profile keyed by UID for live presence, online status, and avatar rendering in chats.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

avatarData.description: Optional avatar URL or Base64 data URI.

DirectoryEntry.title: DirectoryEntry
DirectoryEntry.description: Non-PII lookup index entry keyed by deterministic username key (u_<handle>) or SHA-256 hashed phone key (p_<hash>) for O(1) registered contact verification without exposing raw PII or allowing collection listing.

lookupType.description: Whether this entry maps a username or hashed phone.

avatarData.description: Optional avatar URL or Base64 data URI.

SavedContact.title: SavedContact
SavedContact.description: A verified contact saved in a user's personal contacts list.

contactUid.description: Registered MJ Chatty UID of the contact.

savedName.description: Custom contact label saved by the owner (1-60 chars).

contactPhone.description: Optional phone number typed by the owner (0-20 chars).

registered.description: Whether verified as registered on MJ Chatty.

ChatThread.title: ChatThread
ChatThread.description: Direct or group conversation thread scoped to memberUids with pinning, custom title, typing indicator, and read state metadata.

pinnedByUids.description: Optional list of participant UIDs who pinned this chat.

hiddenByUids.description: Optional list of participant UIDs who deleted/hid this chat from their list.

lockedByUids.description: Optional list of participant UIDs who locked this chat behind their secret code.

pinnedMessageId.description: Optional ID of the currently pinned message in this chat.

pinnedMessagePreview.description: Optional preview text of the currently pinned message.

lastSenderId.description: UID of the sender of the most recent message.

lastMessagePreview.description: Preview snippet of the latest message.

lastMessageType.description: Media type of the latest message.

lastMessageStatus.description: Delivery/read status of the latest message.

typingUid.description: UID of the participant currently typing, or empty string.

typingUpdatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last typing update.

unreadByUid.description: UID of the recipient who has unread messages, or empty string.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Individual real-time text, image, or voice message inside a chat thread with edit, pin, and forward metadata.

memberUids.description: Denormalized participant UIDs for zero-lookup security evaluation.

text.description: Message text or image caption (0-2000 chars).

imageData.description: Optional compressed Base64 JPEG image string.

voiceData.description: Optional compressed Base64 audio clip string.

voiceDurationMs.description: Optional voice note duration in milliseconds.

edited.description: Optional flag indicating the sender edited this message.

editedAt.description: Optional timestamp when the message was last edited.

pinned.description: Optional flag indicating the message is pinned in the chat.

forwarded.description: Optional flag indicating the message was forwarded from another chat.

CallSession.title: CallSession
CallSession.description: Direct WebRTC peer-to-peer audio and video call signaling document and call history log entry.

callerUid.description: UID of the user who initiated the call.

callerAvatar.description: Optional avatar URL or Base64 data URI of caller.

calleeAvatar.description: Optional avatar URL or Base64 data URI of callee.

memberUids.description: Two-element participant UID list for scoped queries.

callType.description: Media type of the WebRTC call.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the call.

offerSdp.description: Optional WebRTC SDP offer generated by the caller.

answerSdp.description: Optional WebRTC SDP answer generated by the callee.

durationSeconds.description: Optional total connected call duration in seconds.

IceCandidateRecord.title: IceCandidateRecord
IceCandidateRecord.description: Trickle-ICE candidate exchanged between WebRTC audio call participants.

senderUid.description: UID of the peer who gathered this ICE candidate.

memberUids.description: Denormalized participant UIDs for zero-lookup security evaluation.

sdpMLineIndex.description: Zero-based index of the m-line in the SDP.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when candidate was published.

PcLinkSession.title: PcLinkSession
PcLinkSession.description: Owner-scoped web browser linking session with cryptographic token, verification code, copyable link URL, and live link status.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who generated this PC link.

deviceLabel.description: Human-readable PC browser or device label (1-40 chars).

pairingCode.description: Short verification code shown alongside the link URL (4-16 chars).

linkToken.description: Cryptographic pairing token embedded in the copyable browser URL (12-64 chars).

linkUrl.description: Full HTTPS URL that can be copied into a PC web browser to link the app (10-500 chars).

status.description: Current status of this PC linking session.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user account profile containing PII (phoneNumber), accessible only by owner.

/users/{userId}/pcLinks/{linkId}.description: User-scoped PC web browser linking sessions and tokens.

/publicProfiles/{profileUid}.description: Non-PII public chat presence and avatar profiles indexed by UID (get-only, no list).

/directory/{lookupId}.description: Non-PII lookup index by u_<username> or p_<sha256(phone)> for live registered contact verification (get-only, no list).

/chats/{chatId}.description: Direct and group chat threads scoped to memberUids.

/chats/{chatId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Messages subcollection with denormalized memberUids for fast secure real-time listeners.

/calls/{callId}.description: WebRTC direct audio call sessions and history scoped to memberUids.

/calls/{callId}/iceCandidates/{candidate.description: WebRTC ICE candidates subcollection with denormalized memberUids.
